changeSet.author: admin
changeSet.comment: Link UZ cities to their geo_region by region code in the region string field
changeSet.sql:
UPDATE geo_city gc SET region_id = gr.id FROM geo_region gr JOIN geo_country gco ON gr.country_id = gco.id WHERE gco.iso2 = 'UZ' AND gc.country = 'UZ' AND gc.region IS NOT NULL AND gc.region_id IS NULL AND gr.full_code = gc.region;
-- Also backfill country_id UPDATE geo_city gc SET country_id = gco.id FROM geo_country gco WHERE gco.iso2 = 'UZ' AND gc.country = 'UZ' AND gc.country_id IS NULL;
